As Caterpillar Del (CAT) Stock Value Rose, Shareholder American Investment Services Lowered Stake by $5.66 Million; Fastenal Company (FAST) Holder Riverbridge Partners Has Raised Stake 
March 2, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
American Investment Services Inc decreased its stake in Caterpillar Inc Del (CAT) by 33.38% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. American Investment Services Inc sold 45,653 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.62% with the market. The institutional investor held 91,107 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.36 million, down from 136,760 at the end of the previous reported quarter. American Investment Services Inc who had been investing in Caterpillar Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $89.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.85% or $4.4   $150.23. About 9.43M shares traded or 66.31% up from the average. Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) has risen 47.53%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.83% the S&P500. 
Riverbridge Partners Llc increased its stake in Fastenal Company (FAST) by 2.65% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Riverbridge Partners Llc bought 49,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.06% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 1.93 million shares of the building materials company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $88.04 million, up from 1.88 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Analysts await Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE:CAT) to report earnings on April, 24. They expect $2.02 earnings per share, up 57.81% or $0.74 from last year’s $1.28 per share. CAT’s profit will be $1.21 billion for 18.59 P/E if the $2.02 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.16 actual earnings per share reported by Caterpillar Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -6.48% negative EPS growth. 
American Investment Services Inc, which manages about $612.10M and $261.23 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pfizer Inc (NYSE:PFE) by 17,554 shares to 410,422 shares, valued at $14.65M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 7,064 shares in the quarter, for a total of 28,405 shares, and has risen its stake in International Business Machs (NYSE:IBM).
